steps.script: () => { const url = location.href; if (url.includes('login') || url.includes('passport')) { throw new Error('redirected to login page: ' + url); } return true; }

(content) => { const ed = document.querySelector('#editor .ql-editor'); if (!ed) { return { success: false, error: 'editor not found' }; } ed.focus(); const sel = window.getSelection(); const range = document.createRange(); range.selectNodeContents(ed); sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(range); const dt = new DataTransfer(); dt.setData('text/html', content); const tmp = document.createElement('div'); tmp.innerHTML = content; dt.setData('text/plain', (tmp.innerText || tmp.textContent || '')); try { ed.dispatchEvent(new ClipboardEvent('paste', { clipboardData: dt, bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); } catch (e) { return { success: false, error: e.message }; } return { success: true }; }
() => { const ed = document.querySelector('#editor .ql-editor'); return !!(ed && ed.innerText && ed.innerText.trim().length > 0); }

() => { const ta = document.querySelector('textarea.abstract-main-textarea'); if (!ta) { return { success: true }; } if (ta.value && ta.value.trim().length > 0) { return { success: true }; } const ed = document.querySelector('#editor .ql-editor'); let text = ed ? (ed.innerText || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() : ''; if (!text) { return { success: true }; } const abstract = text.slice(0, 100); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(ta, abstract); ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return { success: true }; }

() => { const items = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('li, button')); let btn = items.find(el => /publish-report-btn/.test((el.className || '').toString()) && /发布/.test(el.textContent || '')); if (!btn) { btn = items.find(el => /^发布$|立即发布|发布文章/.test((el.innerText || '').trim())); } if (!btn) { return { success: false, error: '未找到发布按钮' }; } const cls = (btn.className || '').toString(); if (/disable/.test(cls) || btn.disabled || btn.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true') { const unverified = (document.body.innerText || '').includes('未实名'); return { success: false, error: '发布按钮不可用' + (unverified ? '（账号未实名认证，搜狐禁止发布文章）' : '（可能正文/标题未就绪）') }; } btn.click(); return { success: true }; }

() => { const norm = (s) => (s || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const isVisible = (el) => { if (!el) return false; const style = window.getComputedStyle(el); if (!style || style.visibility === 'hidden' || style.display === 'none') return false; const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0; }; const dialog = document.querySelector('[role="dialog"], .modal, .dialog, .popup, .alert'); if (!dialog) return { skipped: true }; const btns = Array.from(dialog.querySelectorAll('button, [role="button"], a')).filter(isVisible); const confirm = btns.find(b => /确定|确认|同意|知道了|继续|发布/.test(norm(b.textContent || ''))); if (confirm) { confirm.click(); return { success: true, text: norm(confirm.textContent) }; } return { skipped: true }; }
